iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

ASM::conviction
       Inject conviction honey traps in case of behavioral enforcement is enabled

SYNOPSIS
       ASM::conviction

DESCRIPTION
       Inject conviction honey traps in case of behavioral enforcement is enabled
		Syntax
		   ASM::conviction

RETURN VALUE
       no return value

VALID DURING
       ASM_REQUEST_DONE, ASM_REQUEST_VIOLATION

EXAMPLES
	when ASM_REQUEST_DONE
	{
	    ASM::conviction
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-15.1.0
		--First introduced the command.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
